newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie Scott Dec results meet plan.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie Scott Dec results meet plan.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday its December results were in line with its expectations.

Chief Executive Officer Stanton Bluestone said in a news release, "Although the 1996 holiday season was characterized by continued intense competition, we maintained a less promotional posture during the season and finished the month with comparable-store inventory levels below last year."
He also said, "The five fewer days in the holiday selling season negatively impacted sales results for the month."
The retailer reported comparable-store sales for the five weeks ended January 4 fell 1.2 percent from a year ago.
